children: Camber Energy Inc. (CEIN) filed a Form 8K - Changes to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Change in Fiscal Year - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 14, 2026.

Effective September 8, 2026 at 12:01 a.m. ET, Camber Energy, Inc. (the "Company") changed its corporate name to Viking Global Technologies, Inc. (the "Name Change") pursuant to Articles of Amendment to the Company's Articles of Incorporation (the "Articles of Amendment") filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Nevada on August 27, 2026 pursuant to NRS 78.385 and NRS 78.390.

The Name Change was approved by the Company's Board of Directors by unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting pursuant to NRS 78.315, effective as of August 26, 2026, and did not require stockholder approval pursuant to NRS 78.390. The Name Change does not affect the rights of the Company's stockholders or the number or validity of the Company's issued and outstanding shares of capital stock.

The Company's common stock continues to be quoted on the OTCQB under the trading symbol "CEIN." The Company has submitted the Name Change and a request for a new trading symbol to the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority ("FINRA"). The Company expects to announce the effective date of any trading symbol change following completion of FINRA's processing of the corporate action.
A copy of the Articles of Amendment is filed as Exhibit 3.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1309082/000147793226005582/cei_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1309082/000147793226005582/0001477932-26-005582-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
